images.alt:
This is a fine art architectural photography print, formatted as an A4 poster with a deep teal/steel blue border and a white mat frame around the central image.

The photograph captures a pigeon perched on the horizontal architectural element (the canopy/roof edge) in the lower right area of the photograph. The pigeon is quite small and easy to miss given the scale of the building - adding a tiny point (dot) of organic life to the otherwise stark, geometric scene. 

Main subject is a modern glass skyscraper shot from a dramatic low angle, looking upward. The building features a striking curved, elliptical facade covered in a geometric diamond/triangular grid pattern of glass panels and white aluminium framing. The curve sweeps from the lower left to the upper right of the frame, creating a powerful diagonal composition.

The color treatment is a cool, desaturated blue-teal duotone, giving the image a moody, architectural elegance. The sky in the background is pale and overcast, lending a soft contrast to the structural geometry. A horizontal architectural element (likely a canopy or roof edge) cuts across the lower right corner.

In the bottom right of the border, there is a small photographer's credit that reads *"Dawit D. D. Seyoum"* ( aka Dadasese69).

The photo quietly contrasts the stillness of a pigeon with the routine movements of people, capturing the resigned rhythm of daily urban existence.
